events.title: Developer livestream: Extracto Proviso demo, live from Next Fest
events.summary: We are streaming the Extracto Proviso demo live on Steam during Next Fest, October 19 to 26. Extracto Proviso is first-person factory building on a planet that fights back: belts, pipes, power grids and research on one side, turrets, walls, invasion waves and robot companions on the other. Watch us build from the first miner to a defended base, lose a few fights to the night, and ask anything in the chat. The demo is free and has no time limit during the fest. events.title: Extracto Proviso demo is live for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: The Extracto Proviso demo is playable now, for the whole of Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26. If Satisfactory or Factorio is your game, this is first-person factory building on a planet that fights back. Belts, pipes, power grids and a research tree on one side. Turrets, walls, invasion waves and robot companions on the other. The dirtier your factory runs, the harder the wilderness comes for it.
